title: RetiredCredentialsRegistry
description: Registry of retired credentials across platforms, matching on canonical ID, stable UID, or normalized URL.

id.description: Canonical provider ID, UID, license number, badge ID, or normalized URL.

reason.description: Reason for retirement (e.g. Content retired by provider, Course deprecated).

retired_at.description: ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD) when retirement was recorded or detected.

url.description: Optional original URL for reference or link-checker exclusion.
